articles.summary: It’s not unusual for people to praise their teammates and coworkers at Weyerhaeuser. Many — including Marty Garris, maintenance manager at our oriented strand board plant in Elkin, North Carolina — consider people to be the heart of our core values.
articles.title: For Marty Garris, teamwork makes the machines work at Elkin

articles.summary: It’s no exaggeration to say Jordan LeFever’s lifelong dream has been to work in the health and safety field. Jordan grew up in Butte, Montana, where the community’s mining history played an important role in advancing workplace health and safety protections in the United States.
articles.title: For Jordan LeFever, focusing on health and safety is a way of life
